events.description: Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat around a fallen metal barrier; at least two pairs are seen grappling and striking each other, with visible pushing, grabbing, and swinging motions.

Collective violent unrest unfolds: a metal crowd-control barrier is deliberately knocked over (f2–f3), individuals wield poles as improvised weapons (f0–f1, f4–f5), and a growing group engages in coordinated aggressive actions amid a dense crowd, escalating to open fighting by f10.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat around a fallen metal barrier; participants punch, grapple, and shove each other in a chaotic group fight that persists throughout the interval.

A large crowd surrounds and participates in violent group clashes involving multiple fighters and use of a metal barrier as an object in the conflict; behavior exceeds isolated fighting and constitutes collective violent unrest.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat around a black car and a tipped-over metal cart; visible punching, grappling, and shoving occur across frames f0–f6.

Large group of people actively involved in violent unrest: objects thrown (e.g., debris on ground by f13), carts overturned, chaotic movement, and sustained aggressive interactions beyond isolated fighting; includes destruction of property and collective aggression.

At least one individual appears to be on the ground or incapacitated near the overturned cart (visible in f12–f15), while others continue to strike or kick toward them, suggesting attack on a helpless victim.
Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat near a black car; one person in dark clothing swings at another while others surround and grapple.

A large, agitated crowd surges around street vendors and vehicles; objects are thrown or knocked over (e.g., overturned trash can in f4–f8), and chaotic movement suggests collective violent unrest beyond isolated fighting.

Two individuals appear to be engaged in close physical struggle; one person in dark clothing is seen pushing or grappling with another, with visible body contact and motion consistent with mutual combat.

A person in a white shirt appears to be on the ground or bent over while another individual leans over them in a dominant posture; the context suggests possible targeting of a vulnerable individual, though visibility is extremely limited.
